author: KEXP
description: Under gritty guitars and raw vocals, Detroit-born artist @jmsn feeds an insatiable drive to create and grow with his alt-rock record '…it's only about u if you think it is.' Live on KEXP, he shares a performance of "I Don't Even Think About U" and more.
title: JMSN performs "I Don't Even Think About U" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
